This demo shows the Comment Mention plugin in action - it lets user tag other users in the comment section, similar to @mentions on social media.

How to try it

  • Scroll down to the comment form below.
  • Type @ followed by a few letters of a username (e.g. @a).
  • Pick a user from the autocomplete dropdown that appears.
  • Submit your comment — the mentioned user is notified and linked in the comment.
  • You can configure mention settings in the plugin settings page.
